svg.text: k3s on a 16 GB Mac: simulated 8x H100 fleet + 24-OSD Ceph, GPU acceptance testing, MAAS + Terraform provisioning
kubectl → API: node status patches, cordon, pod restarts
SLOs · k6 load from the Mac
3 mons, pools, PGs (runs on a worker)
InfiniBand NDR 400G fabric · 8 rails · GPU-to-GPU (NCCL) traffic only
FW drift · FM mismatch · PCIe x8
full OSD · host down · slow ops
LAYER 1 — Host: MacBook Pro M2, 16 GB RAM (k3s VMs 11 GB + maas VM 4 GB: stop maas when idle)
LAYER 2 — Virtualization: Multipass VMs on Apple Hypervisor.framework
LAYER 3 — Kubernetes (k3s) workloads on cp1 / w1 / w2
LAYER 4 — Simulated fleets: 14 KWOK fake nodes (real Node objects, no real hardware)
LAYER 5 — Bare-metal target, modelled in Terraform (plan-only): Dell fleet + DC network plan
